jobs.description: Partner Development Manager We're hiring a Partner Development Manager to run three revenue programs that sit inside AppsFlyer's Partnership org: the AWS partnership, the Success Fee referral program, and the Credit Program. As a Partner Development Manager, you will serve as a crucial bridge within the organization, driving growth and strategic execution for three critical initiatives by collaborating seamlessly with the sales, partnership, and RevOps teams, as well as our external partners. This includes driving our AWS partnership through end-to-end relationship management, scaling the credit program to drive channel growth, and overseeing the global success fee program to maximize referral opportunities and optimize the business model. What you'll own AWS Partnership Own AppsFlyer's AWS co-sell motion helping Sales and PDMs decide when a deal benefits from AWS insight or the Marketplace, and driving those deals to close. Position the Marketplace as an early, proactive negotiating asset to expand deal size, extend deal length, and win price-sensitive or competitive opportunities. Partner day-to-day with our AWS Partner Manager to advance the AppsFlyer–AWS Strategic Collaboration Agreement (SCA), and manage AWS Account Managers, PDMs, and regional teams to unlock account insight and advocacy. Enable AppsFlyer sales teams to spot co-sell early and apply best practices, and educate AWS reps on who AppsFlyer is and why to advocate for us. Own the internal Marketplace process with Rev Ops and Deal Desk — submission, approvals, private offers, and billing — and steward partner-funding programs such as MPOPP. Success Fee Program Own the Success Fee referral program end-to-end: partner qualification, referral validation, approval , and payout as the final decision-maker on what is and isn't accepted. Act as the program's gatekeeper: validate referrals against a clear attribution standard, reject opportunistic or ineligible requests, and prevent revenue cannibalization and after-the-fact credit. Run the prioritized-accounts motion, working with partners and sales leaders on intentional account mapping that unlocks higher-value, higher-commitment referrals. Continuously develop the program — its fee model, portal experience (PartnerStack), and reporting — and champion new field-driven initiatives that scale partner impact. Collaborate with the Partnership team and Commercial Partnership team to build pipeline and secure partner commitment. Define and improve processes to scale the program. Onboard new partners to the program. Who you are 5+ years in partnerships, alliances, business development, or commercial sales within SaaS, AdTech, or a related B2B technology field. A proven dealmaker who has grown revenue through partnerships and navigated complex, multi-stakeholder deals. A natural orchestrator who influences outcomes across Sales, Revenue Operations, Finance, and Deal Desk without direct authority. Principled and disciplined — able to say no, protect program integrity, and balance partner goodwill against the company's revenue interests. A compelling communicator who makes complex commercial ideas simple for any audience, and a daily AI user in how you research, prioritize, and decide. Entrepreneurial and self-directed, energized by owning ambiguous, high-leverage programs. Preferred Experience with cloud co-sell or a cloud marketplace (AWS, GCP, or Azure). Experience running a partner referral / incentive program and a PRM platform. Familiarity with the mobile measurement / AdTech ecosystem. &

jobs.title: Salary Controller
jobs.description: AppsFlyer’s Finance Team is looking for an experienced Salary Controller to join our payroll team and lead end-to-end payroll operations for a large, global workforce. The role is focused on Israeli payroll today, with room to grow into global payroll responsibilities over time. This role requires deep expertise across payroll processes, labor law, reporting to authorities, and the ability to handle complex cases in a fast-changing environment-while working closely with multiple stakeholders across the business. This is a role for someone who wants to do more than execute: you'll be expected to bring AI and automation into how payroll is run, shaping new tools and processes as the function grows. This is an outstanding opportunity to learn and grow within a fast-paced, dynamic global company, working with global standards and diverse stakeholders. What you’ll do - Global standards: Own and analyze end-to-end payroll processes for 700+ employees, as part of the Payroll team, ensuring accuracy and compliance. Maintain and validate payroll master data across the employee lifecycle (onboarding, changes, terminations), ensuring data integrity across systems. Manage complex payroll cases (e.g., terminations, relocations, special benefits, corrections, retro payments, equity implications, leaves, garnishments, and exceptions). Lead payroll activities for month-end / quarter-end close, including reconciliations, variance analysis, and support for payroll journal entries and GL reporting. Partner closely with HR, Finance, Legal, and external vendors/consultants on payroll operations, compliance topics, and process improvements. Support internal/external audits and work with auditors to ensure documentation, controls, and payroll reports are audit-ready. Drive continuous improvement: build, document, and optimize payroll workflows, controls, and reporting in a fast-paced, changing environment. What you bring (Must-have): 3 years of hands-on payroll experience from a large scale global company (preferably 700+ employees). Proven end-to-end payroll expertise, including calculations, benefits, deductions, reporting, and compliance. Solid understanding of payroll regulations and statutory reporting; ability to quickly learn and apply local labor and tax requirements (Israeli payroll knowledge is a strong advantage). Ability to manage high volume, tight deadlines, and frequent changes with high accuracy. Strong team player with a collaborative mindset, able to work effectively with multiple stakeholders (HR, Finance, Legal, external providers). High attention to detail, ownership, discretion, and integrity. Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, lookups, xlookups, reconciliations, data validation) and ability to analyze large datasets. Strong curiosity for technology and automation, with a genuine interest in applying AI tools to payroll operations and reporting. Fluent English (written and spoken) - an advantage. Bonus Points: Hands-on experience with Hilan systems: Hilan Pro, Hilan NEXT, Hilanet (time & attendance). Experience with global payroll systems and/or supporting payroll activities outside Israel. Experience with NetSuite and HRIS platforms (Oracle - an advantage). Hands-on experience applying AI or automation tools to payroll, HR, or reporting workflows. This role serves as the senior technical security authority across our R&D ecosystem- partnering with product, platform, and infrastructure teams to embed security into every layer of our Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC) and to guide AppsFlyer toward a robust, modern, and secure architecture. The ideal candidate is highly professional, demonstrates a ‘can-do’ attitude, and brings the seniority and presence to engage R&D architects and senior stakeholders as a peer. You will need strong technical depth, excellent communication skills, and the ability to translate complex security considerations into clear business and engineering decisions across a diverse range of stakeholders. jobs.title: Senior Support Engineer
jobs.description: We are looking for a Senior Support Engineer to join our Israel-based support team. This role is critical to maintaining excellent service for our English and Hebrew-speaking customers, handling complex technical and customer-facing issues independently, and helping the team adapt to the next generation of AI-enabled support workflows. The ideal candidate is a strong hands-on problem solver, an excellent communicator in Hebrew and English, and a senior team player who can elevate team quality, partner closely with leadership, and contribute to improving our internal tools, AI-based workflows, and support processes. This is a hands-on senior individual contributor role with broad impact. In addition to resolving complex customer issues end to end, this person will help shape how support operates in an evolving environment that increasingly includes automation and AI-assisted workflows and tools. Why this role matters Israel is a critical support hub for our business. Some of our customers require high-quality support in Hebrew, especially in complex or sensitive cases where local language, context, and live communication are essential. At the same time, the support role is becoming more complex. AI-based tools and automation are becoming part of daily work, raising the bar for ownership, judgment, adaptability, and cross-functional collaboration. We need a senior team member who can thrive in this environment, help the team adopt new ways of working, and contribute to improving the tools and processes we use. What you’ll do Own complex technical and product-related support cases from investigation through resolution. Provide high-quality support to customers in Hebrew and English across written and live interactions. Handle ambiguous, high-impact, or cross-functional issues with strong judgment and minimal supervision. Act as a senior point of contact for escalations, sensitive customer situations, and priority cases. Mentor teammates by sharing knowledge, setting a high bar for case handling, and helping improve team practices. Use AI-based tools and internal tools effectively in day-to-day work to improve speed, quality, and consistency. Help to define, maintain and improve support agents, AI-assisted tools, bots, workflows, automations and documentation to improve support effectiveness. Identify opportunities to reduce friction, improve self-service, and optimize internal support flows. Collaborate with Product, R&D, Customer Success, TPE, and other internal stakeholders to resolve issues and improve the customer experience. What we’re looking for 5+ years of experience in technical support, support engineering, or similar customer-facing technical roles in a SaaS or technology environment. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work through complex cases independently. jobs.title: Software Team Leader
jobs.description: AppsFlyer is a global leader in marketing measurement, attribution, and data collaboration, helping brands make better business decisions with privacy-first technologies at massive scale. Our platform processes hundreds of billions of data points every day, powering mission-critical products with a strong focus on scalability, reliability, and trust. The Engagement team owns OneLink , AppsFlyer's deep linking and attribution link platform. Every OneLink click is a real user waiting: someone taps a link in an ad, a social post, an email, or a QR code, and within milliseconds we have to resolve the link, record the engagement, and send them to the right place. That means the app store, the app itself, or a specific in-app screen, on the right platform, in the right context. The team sits at the very front of AppsFlyer's ingestion path and handles millions of requests per second globally. Our services cover the full journey: OneLink and shortlink resolution, redirection at the edge, deferred deep linking for users who install first and deep link after, social crawler link previews, and delivery of clean engagement data onto Kafka for downstream attribution. We're looking for a hands-on Software Team Leader to lead the Engagement team, owning the architecture, delivery, and production health of the OneLink serving path. Our stack is deliberately polyglot: Clojure, Go, Java, and Node , with the persistence layer chosen per problem across Kafka, Redis/ElastiCache, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, and MongoDB . Everything runs on AWS (Kubernetes, multi-region), behind CDNs at the edge What You’ll Do Lead, mentor, and grow a team of senior backend engineers, covering hiring, career growth, and honest feedback, while staying personally hands-on in architecture, design reviews, and code. Own the end-to-end design of the OneLink serving path. Own the edge layer together with Infra, including CDN strategy across branded and non-branded domain and edge compute. Own production, including SLOs, capacity, and cost efficiency at scale, and take part in the on-call rotation. Partner with Product, Data, and Infra to turn ambiguous requirements into a sequenced technical plan. What You Have Engineering experience: 5+ years of software development experience, with strong backend engineering skills. Leadership: 2+ years directly managing a team of software engineers, including hiring, performance, and growth conversations. High scale in production: Proven track record designing, building, and operating high-throughput, low-latency distributed systems. Cloud: Strong proficiency with AWS (or GCP/Azure) and modern deployment practice, including containers, Kubernetes, IaC, and CI/CD. Polyglot backend: Hands-on depth in at least one of Go, Clojure, Node, or Java, and genuine willingness to work across all of them. Multi-DB: Comfort with both relational (PostgreSQL) and NoSQL/caching (DynamoDB, MongoDB, Redis/ElastiCache), with real opinions on when each is wrong. Streaming: Working knowledge of Kafka or equivalent, including partitioning, consumer groups, ordering, backpressure, and what happens when a consumer falls behind. B.Sc. in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience Bonus Points Deep linking, mobile attribution, or URL routing experience (Universal Links, App Links, deferred deep linking). CDN and edge-compute work: CloudFront Functions, CloudFlare Workers, WAF rule design. Functional programming experience (Clojure, Scala, Erlang/Elixir). AdTech background.
